story: Waiʻanapanapa State Park is a 122-acre state park in Hana, on the island of Maui, in Hawaii. Its natural features include coastal mesic forests, seabird colonies, lava tubes, and anchialine pools.
matters: The anchialine tide pools at the park turn red several times a year due to the arrival of shrimp species like Halocaridina rubra and Metabetaeus lohena.
name: Waiʻanapanapa State Park
